zh-CN.name: 凯旋圣歌
zh-CN.realgame_details: 进入输出前配合完美逆行{perk|金中藏弹}空洞拒绝捡子弹常与众神辉煌配合使用\\{art-perk|动能合成}武器输出时用于拾取弹药盒填装，比如{perk|级联点}{perk|全明星}威胁等级

description.en: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
description.zh-CN: 滑行会收集附近的弹药，并在短时间内为你的武器提供强化的填装速度和操控性。

description.en: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
description.zh-CN: 用武器造成伤害会在短时间内提供强化滑行。滑行时会获得伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 欧里克斯记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 击杀{bar-orange|橙血}额外弹药进度

description.en: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 对守护者和强力战斗人员造成最后一击时生成额外的弹药进度。

description.en: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，你获得隐形。

zh-CN.name: 光耀万钧
zh-CN.realgame_details: 电术双炮台、地磁靴搭配{el-arc|电荷思维}双倍{el-arc|离子轨迹}大招回转

description.en: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
description.zh-CN: 当处于增幅状态时，你的融合步枪、线性融合步枪以及热量武器可获得更高的操控性、填装和排气速度。

description.en: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
description.zh-CN: 以震颤造成最后一击，或对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击时，会生成离子轨迹。

zh-CN.name: 埃希恩记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 最好最泛用的套装，可以优化掉一切配装中与产球有关的模组换成洗礼；{el-prismatic|棱镜}持续触发{el-prismatic|使命琢面}软硬减、{el-void|虚空}持续触发{el-void|饥饿回声}触发吞噬回血；同时他也是最好用的输出套装，持续补充{armor-charge|护甲充能}、给予生存能力、质变金枪狙/{art-perk|银白重炮}神器等等

description.en: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，在短时间内获得生命值属性加成并向周围释放一股活性放射体液。

description.en: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 拥有分支职业增益时，造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

zh-CN.name: 传承之誓
zh-CN.realgame_details: 10m {deb-arc|致盲}范围足够，最合适的是火小锤泰坦和升龙电猎，能够大大减少空近战的情况。飞蛾和好耶大范围近战通常会将周围怪一起击杀

description.en: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
description.zh-CN: 使用充能近战击败目标时额外释放一道迷失脉冲。

description.en: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
description.zh-CN: 你的护盾被战斗人员击破，或你使用超能时，发射大量追踪热源的微型导弹。

zh-CN.name: 艾昂适配
zh-CN.realgame_details: 爆炸武器击杀获取长达 15 秒的 20% 范围减伤\\注：范围伤害在所有伤害来源中大约占据 50% 的比例，等效 10% 减伤

description.en: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
description.zh-CN: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，暂时减少受到的范围效果伤害。

description.en: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
description.zh-CN: 力量吸收生效时，受到近战伤害将触发一次迷失爆发。

zh-CN.name: 终曲
zh-CN.realgame_details: 低压环境击杀提供可观近战和手雷回转，对技能相关配装很有用（逃逸手、好耶泰坦等），抵抗 3 是锦上添花。摧毁构造体可触发，但仅有{exotic|死亡信使}霜袍术适合，冰猎和冰泰坦贪婪套更优

description.en: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
description.zh-CN: 光能武器最后一击提供赋予手雷属性的光能极性层数。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供赋予近战属性的暗影极性层数。

description.en: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
description.zh-CN: 光能武器最后一击提供额外手雷能量。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供额外近战能量。光能与暗影交替的快速最后一击在短时间内提供伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 渴望回响
zh-CN.realgame_details: 对元素拾取物多的电冰职业多给予的技能能量非常慷慨（几乎都是翻倍能量），有质变的效果。2 件套减伤

description.en: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药、能量球、元素拾取物，或摧毁缚丝缠结时获得无尽贪婪层数，略微降低所受伤害，并为已装备武器提供填装速度加成。当你的护盾被击破时，会失去部分层数。

description.en: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
description.zh-CN: 拥有无尽贪婪层数时，能量球和元素拾取物会提供更多对应能量，并且提升缚丝缠结造成的伤害。当你的护盾被击破时，所有层数会转化为一股能量球的泉涌。

zh-CN.name: 定制特机
zh-CN.realgame_details: 唯一的额外增伤效果套装，很适合剑狙翻新双切，好建议三切等等

description.en: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
description.zh-CN: 在击败一名强力战斗人员或守护者后收起武器，会为自身恢复少量生命值，并使附近战斗人员迷失方向。

description.en: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
description.zh-CN: 新拔出的武器在短时间内对战斗人员造成的精准伤害获得提升。装备特克斯平衡枪托原始特性的武器或由特克斯机械铸造厂制造的异域装备将获得进一步的提升。

zh-CN.name: 深渊探索者
zh-CN.realgame_details: 适合只有硬减没有软减的分支职业，输出场景也可以使用

description.en: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
description.zh-CN: 受到伤害会提升你已装备武器的填装速度，直到收起该武器。受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

description.en: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
description.zh-CN: 当你收起武器时，根据失去的苦涩锻造层数恢复生命值。

zh-CN.name: 黑暗纪元
zh-CN.realgame_details: 职业技能会释放一个小型治疗无人机，适合{el-strand|缚丝}猎松身裤这种缺少软减的分支。{el-prismatic|棱镜}{el-void|虚空}适合 vog4，火猎适合减伤套装。然而在多人环境下为所有人提供治疗效果非常不错，可根据自身需求选择，谁更优秀并不是绝对的。部分人可能会出现无法释放治疗无人机的 bug，切换套装或者让主动出击 buff 自然流失完可以解决

description.en: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
description.zh-CN: 使用近战攻击或刀剑打击命中战斗人员可获得主动出击层数，从而提升操控性和填装。层数会随时间缓慢衰减。

description.en: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
description.zh-CN: 拥有主动出击层数时，使用职业技能会生成一个位置固定的治疗光环。该光环的治疗量基于主动出击层数而提升。

zh-CN.name: 机械营套装
zh-CN.realgame_details: 加拉诺冰镐/{el-void|虚空}箭、{exotic|阿罕卡拉之颅}涡流大招、{exotic|圣火护心甲}无法正常生效\\持续型大招可以通过切换套装来刷新触发效果

description.en: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
description.zh-CN: 提升主弹药武器的操控性和填装速度。根据你的武器属性，提升主弹药武器对非首领战斗人员造成的伤害。

description.en: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
description.zh-CN: 超能生效期间造成的最后一击将在超能结束后返还超能能量。

zh-CN.name: 梦境祸根
zh-CN.realgame_details: 获得的梦魇精华 buff 套用的就是原本的梦魇精华代码，可以获得对梦魇{enemy|战斗人员}大幅额外增伤，而二象性地牢的{bar-yellow|首领}全都是梦魇

description.en: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员或高阶目标造成最后一击可获得不稳定精华。拥有不稳定精华时，你会获得手雷和近战属性加成。

description.en: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
description.zh-CN: 拥有不稳定精华时，你的快速武器伤害或最后一击会提供治疗并开启生命值回复。

zh-CN.name: 众神辉煌
zh-CN.realgame_details: 捡起子弹获取{armor-charge|护甲充能}，常与凯旋圣歌配合使用\\也有搭配{art-perk|治疗能量球}/{art-perk|碎裂能量球}神器+层层不绝无限踢绿弹的玩法，实际使用不多

description.en: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药提供护甲充能。每层护甲充能都会提供生命值属性加成。

description.en: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
description.zh-CN: 对初级首领、勇士和首领造成持续伤害会提升对基础和强力战斗人员造成的武器伤害。每次造成武器最后一击时消耗一层。

zh-CN.name: 剑圣
zh-CN.realgame_details: 适合偃月玩法的高额抵抗 4 减伤

description.en:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
description.zh-CN:
使用刀剑、偃月或任意近战攻击伤害目标会使其疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

description.en: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
description.zh-CN: 使用刀剑或偃月格挡攻击后，下次解除格挡时，会在短时间内获得针对目标的伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 奈扎雷克的梦魇
zh-CN.realgame_details: 低压环境的产球选择，任意击杀 3 个元素{debuff|减益}影响的{enemy|战斗人员}就能产出{orb|能量球}，适合不稳定弹药/拆解子弹武器，逃逸手/忍野等等一切有频繁元素{debuff|减益}的玩法，{art-perk|压制偃月}虫手泰坦也是优秀的使用案例\\适合与空降灭火套装配合使用

description.en: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 对受到分支职业减益影响的目标造成最后一击有递增的几率生成能量球。

description.en: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
description.zh-CN: 对强力战斗人员施展终结技可提供吞食。拥有吞食时，获得对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 克洛塔记忆
zh-CN.realgame_details: 类似{perk|混沌重塑}机制的减伤效果，脱战 7 秒后才失去效果比较理想

description.en: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
description.zh-CN: 近战最后一击会触发一次诅咒怨魂爆炸。

description.en: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
description.zh-CN: 处于战斗中一段时间会逐渐获得更多对战斗人员的抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

zh-CN.name: 应许之物
zh-CN.realgame_details: 只需要击杀{bar-orange|橙血}就可以获得抵抗 X2 和额外武器增伤 12 秒，持续时间长并且很容易获取。无法与其他抵抗来源叠加

description.en: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
description.zh-CN: 击败强力战斗人员会生成稳定共振，在持续时间内提供伤害抗性和提升武器伤害。

description.en: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
description.zh-CN: 拥有稳定共振时，持续造成武器伤害偶尔会产生共振爆发，伤害目标并使其疲惫。

zh-CN.name: 空降灭火套装
zh-CN.realgame_details: 持续{orb|能量球}产出的不错减伤来源，适合与梦根 2 或者小锤泰坦等高频产球配装搭配使用

description.en: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
description.zh-CN: 拾取能量球时，你会获得短暂且快速衰减的伤害减免效果。

description.en: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
description.zh-CN: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员可获得特殊弹药进度，并恢复少量生命值。

zh-CN.name: 溢冰
zh-CN.realgame_details: bug 的每 12 秒一次弹药进度和{orb|能量球}

description.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
description.zh-CN: 脱离战斗一定时间后，你的下一次最后一击提供额外弹药进度并生成一个能量球。

description.en: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
description.zh-CN: 脱离战斗一定时间后，缓慢获得冰霜护甲直到你再次进入战斗。

zh-CN.name: 移民号陨落
zh-CN.realgame_details: 简单获取的常驻减伤效果，需要有{orb|能量球}产出，因为 4 层充能后收益不佳，不需要携带多个完全充能，通常只需要 1 个层层不绝+绿弹终结/快速启动模组即可

description.en: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
description.zh-CN: 你的护盾被击破时，自动收集附近所有的能量球与弹药盒。

description.en:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
description.zh-CN:
获得、失去或消耗护甲充能时，在短时间内获得治疗和伤害减免。

此效果根据获得、失去和消耗的护甲充能数量而调整。

zh-CN.name: 双重王冠
zh-CN.realgame_details: 搭配{art-perk|动能合成}作为有效回血手段，常与光剑圣贤搭配

description.en: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
description.zh-CN: 拾取弹药盒会治疗你。

description.en: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
description.zh-CN: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升你雷达的分辨率。

zh-CN.name: 积雨云
zh-CN.realgame_details: 只对近距离 5m 范围内的{enemy|战斗人员}有减伤，数值够高，适合一些频繁使用手雷的配装（忍野、幼龙手）。原本是最适配勾爪肘击的套装，但是现在强度不足基本没上场空间

description.en: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
description.zh-CN: 激活手雷或纳米技术追踪导弹原始特性会为近距离来袭伤害提供可叠加的抗性。

description.en: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
description.zh-CN: 击败被瓦解的战斗人员会提供手雷技能能量。如果你的手雷能量已充满，则获得特殊弹药量表进度。

zh-CN.name: 铁能
zh-CN.realgame_details: 触发条件简单，抵抗 1 几乎常驻。不能与其他抵抗来源叠加

description.en: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
description.zh-CN: 当你的护盾开始回复时，你在短时间内获得抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

description.en: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
description.zh-CN: 当你的弹药储备较低时，使用武器对战斗人员造成最后一击，会根据武器弹药类型提供额外的弹药进度。主弹药武器可提升特殊弹药进度，特殊弹药武器可提升重型弹药进度。

zh-CN.name: 圣贤保护者
zh-CN.realgame_details: 单独用效果一般，但是剑刃风暴连击可以触发大大提升了技能回转能力\\常与光剑王冠套配合使用

description.en: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
description.zh-CN: 刀剑命中返还手雷和职业能量。如果启用利刃专注，还将获得额外能量。

description.en: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
description.zh-CN: 使用刀剑短暂格档来让利刃专注就绪。利刃专注就绪时，用刀剑命中目标会在一定时间内提升刀剑伤害和前冲距离。
